records.decision: Dated local reporting quotes Kaw Gaming's closure decision, effective January 1, 2022. Current named map says permanently closed; old operator domain redirects to Braman. Newkirk is not a current additional Kaw casino. Rock & Brews Braman remains separate and active. Final live-provider browser review surfaced the stale OSM name Kaw Southwind Casino without Newkirk; that exact alias is now covered by the same geographic closure bounds. No broader name suppression.
records.recheckTrigger: Review only when credible evidence of a new operating casino or confirmed reopening appears; do not schedule repetitive checks of demolished/retired properties.

records.decision: Independent Apple named-casino metadata (34.9394807,-96.6838545) and Google Rivermist entity (34.939424,-96.683884) agree with operator name/address/phone. Rejected tourism city-area point, operator viewport/intersection wording and nearby retail point.
records.recheckTrigger: Only a credible relocation or status change; preserve Konawa/Rivermist as one casino.

records.decision: Current Cactus Petes operator describes Horseshu hotel rooms. Historical tourism casino wording and corporate subsidiary naming do not demonstrate a currently operating separate Horseshu gaming floor. The hotel component belongs to the combined Cactus Petes operation; a second casino is unproven.
records.recheckTrigger: Current operator statement or dated floor-specific evidence confirming public gaming at Horseshu itself, plus a named building point; historical hotel/casino labels do not qualify.

records.decision: Current tribe confirms the operating travel plaza but does not describe gaming. Industry directory describes a small gaming area while Yelp marks the casino listing closed. Neither a directory refresh date nor an old tribal compact resolves present floor operation.
records.recheckTrigger: Dated tribal/operator confirmation that a public dedicated casino floor is operating, resolving the closed casino listing; then verify the floor's property point.

records.decision: March 14, 2023 operator announcement gives May 14, 2023 closure. Current map permanently closed. Stale tourism listings do not outweigh this; active Prairie Moon is a different site.
records.recheckTrigger: Revisit only upon credible new operating/reopening evidence; do not schedule routine checks of a confirmed retired site.

records.decision: Operator roster lists casino at 255 W Main; its named KML point is 39.6077442,-119.2557446. Apple Wigwam restaurant point 39.6074984,-119.2542905 instead says 265 W Main. Google restaurant says 255. Same phone supports identity but does not resolve the roughly 400-foot casino-point discrepancy. Do not route to an unconfirmed entrance.
records.recheckTrigger: Operator-confirmed casino building/entrance geometry tying 255/265 W Main and the KML point to the operating floor.

records.property: Broadway Colt Inn Casino — Battle Mountain
records.decision: Named Colt Casino point 40.6483306,-116.9434661 and Broadway Diner point 40.6483607,-116.9435101 agree on the same building. Separately mapped RV park 40.6494114,-116.9461713 is rejected. Casino entry is 654 W Front, diner 650; tourism and indexed operator identity support the property.
records.recheckTrigger: Only credible relocation/rebranding/status change; retain casino building point and do not substitute RV point.

records.decision: Lovelock Junction website advertises hotel/casino; Casino City lists machines, but legacy C Punch map remains permanently closed and SureStay confirms hotel only. The 2025 Off the Rails case concerns 150 Main Street, not this Cornell Avenue property, so it cannot clear the gaming hold.
records.recheckTrigger: Current operator or floor-specific evidence of active public casino gaming at 1420/1440 Cornell, with renamed identity and property point reconciled.

records.decision: Operator confirms casino floor at the NV/UT border. Current named Google entity is a hotel at 39.056507,-114.0491242; operator contact directions use 39.0565772,-114.0489053. Neither is floor-specific boundary evidence. No arbitrary westward pin adjustment was made.
records.recheckTrigger: Casino-building or entrance coordinates with reliable boundary/parcel geometry proving the Nevada gaming side, independently of hotel/RV points.

records.decision: Adversarial review rejected provisional promotion: TravelOK describes on-site slots but is undated and has an incorrect street number; tribal tourism's Casino amenity and operator's 'room or next-door casino' wording do not establish the old 34-machine room still operates separately after Border Casino's expansion. Indexed Yelp/PlugShare room comments could not be dated; fetched 2026 PlugShare check-ins discuss chargers only. Operator property point 33.7361191,-97.1441414 is resolved, but current separate floor remains unproven.
records.recheckTrigger: Dated operator confirmation or verifiable current on-site evidence of a separate internal CTS gaming room after the Border Casino expansion, with identity and address distinct from Border Casino.

records.decision: June 2025 NGCB complaint establishes a nonrestricted slots casino operated by SRY Industries at 150 Main Street. Settlement retains a conditioned license. Current map query returns only Lovelock city, not a casino entity. No numerical property point/current public operating identity was established; do not assign the city-center result or conflate with Cornell Avenue Lovelock Junction.
records.recheckTrigger: Current operator identity and a named casino/building point at 150 Main, or a documented successor/closure; reject generic Lovelock coordinates.
